title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
abstract: arXiv:2610.29477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Codes of professional ethics guide and restrict specialists, who increasingly work with assistants built on large language models. Such an assistant can breach the user's code, or help the user breach it, without the user noticing. Evaluations reporting broad categories of harm cannot show how often this happens or which provision is breached. TenetBench pairs 3,433 requests conflicting with clauses of fifteen Russian-language professional codes with benign twins that differ only in the legitimacy of what is asked. An automated pipeline generates the tasks from the text of a code, so the corpus grows with every code added and a provision yields new tasks on every run. It also produced tasks and human-validated verdicts from two English codes of other jurisdictions. translated_title: TenetBench：一个以条款为锚点的俄语语料库，用于依据职业伦理准则评估语言模型
translated_abstract: 职业伦理准则指导和约束专业人士，而这些人越来越频繁地使用基于大语言模型构建的智能助手。这样的助手可能会在用户毫无察觉的情况下违反用户所遵循的职业准则，或帮助用户违反准则。仅报告广义伤害类别的评估无法揭示这种情况发生的频率，也无法指明具体违反了哪项条款。TenetBench 将 3,433 个与十五部俄语职业伦理准则条款相冲突的请求，与仅在所请求内容合法性上存在差异的良性孪生请求一一配对。一个自动化流水线从准则文本中生成任务，因此语料库会随着每部新准则的加入而扩展，且每次运行都会从同一条款产生新的任务。该流水线还为两部来自其他司法辖区的英语准则生成了任务和经人工验证的判定结果。在对冻结流水线的人工验证中，专家认为 0.995 的冲突任务是合理的，且模型裁判与人工裁定的标签一致性达到 Gwet's AC1 的……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 TenetBench——一个由自动化流水线从职业伦理准则文本生成的俄语基准语料库，包含 3,433 个与准则条款冲突的请求及其良性孪生对照，可随着新准则加入持续扩展，用于精细评估大语言模型是否会违反或帮助用户违反具体的职业伦理条款。
en_tdlr: TenetBench introduces an automatically generated, clause-anchored Russian benchmark of 3,433 requests conflicting with professional codes of ethics, paired with benign twins, enabling fine-grained evaluation of whether language models violate—or help users violate—specific ethical provisions, and the corpus grows with every code added.
